entries.notes:
This is an editorial entry, so there is no Lean statement to compare. 'Faithful' here means that the applied text is the corrected text and that each edit is true of the figures.

(1) Labels. The comparison figure keeps fig:toyimg (v2 l.611, v1 l.587), as the corrected says. The other five definitions (v1 l.1004, 1023, 1213, 1313, 1416) are renamed, and each new name matches its figure. fig:depth_ablation (l.1041) is the figure of ablation/22..26.png and 32..62.png, captioned 'depths from 2x32 to 6x32'. fig:minimal_checker (l.1061) is images/checker_minimal{,_samples}, the four-affine-move EGF on T^2 at 4x128. fig:size_star (l.1252) is ablation/star_*.png, the 'spin wheel' panels. fig:size_circles (l.1353) is ablation/4Circles/*.png. fig:size_spirals (l.1458) is ablation/2spiral/*.png. Each label is now defined once, and the new labels do not collide with any existing label in main.tex or math_command.tex.

(2) References. main.tex has one figure reference among these labels, \ref{fig:toyimg} at l.518 (v1 l.494). Its sentence ('shows how Moser Flow fails to train with such a small model while minimal EGF reproduces the target distribution') means the Moser/DDPM/EGF 32x3 comparison. The aux file gives {2}{8} for fig:toyimg, and pdftotext reads 'Figure 2 shows how Moser Flow fails', where the base build reads 'Figure 10'. No other reference changed. The new figure labels are not referenced, which is harmless. \ref{sec:appendix_backward} (l.230) still resolves to A.

(3) Stray comma. The comma after the label at v1 l.729 is removed (v2 l.753). The base PDF prints a lone ',' under 'A. Fundamentals of EGFs'. v2 does not.

(4) The l.431 parenthesis. The corrected text is applied verbatim, with one change: the corrected's 'Appendix F' becomes 'Appendix~\ref{sec:size_ablation}', and \label{sec:size_ablation} is added to the section heading (v2 l.972, v1 l.936). In both the base and the v2 build, that section is 'E. Ablation study on the size of EGF'. The appendix sections are A Fundamentals, B Universality, C Quantitative Sampling, D Implementation considerations and E Ablation. So E is right and the register's F is wrong. The label is the minimal mechanism for the reference: it prints nothing, it renumbers nothing, and it carries a marker. A literal 'Appendix E' would also be correct, but it would go stale if T-egf-v2-package inserts its 'Changes from v1' appendix before E. I count the label as within scope (see finding 1 for the register sync).

Whether the parenthesis is true depends on what 'the size ablations' covers. Appendix E has five figures. Figures 8, 9 and 10 (star, 4 circles, 2 spirals) state R^2, 8 translations and f_out zero outside [-4,4]^2. Figure 6, the depth ablation, is a size ablation, but its caption states no state space. Its images show a checkerboard on [-2,2]^2, drawn in the same [-5,5]^2 frame and with the same background square (about [-3.5,3.5]^2) as the R^2 panels (compare ablation/22.png and 62.png with ablation/2spiral/4x128.png and 5x128.png). That is the R^2 setting, not the torus. ~/egf-reproduction/configs/ablations_r2.toml reads it off the images the same way. Figure 7 is on T^2, as its caption says, but it is a single 4x128 run that varies no size, so 'the size ablations' excludes it on the natural reading. So the parenthesis is true: of Figures 8-10 by their captions, and of Figure 6 by its images. Figure 7 states its own space, so no reader is misled about it. A reader who takes 'of Appendix E' to mean the whole appendix is the residual risk (finding 3).

(5) The l.1409 subcaption. It now reads 'from 2x64 to 3x64, then 4x128 and 5x128 (TOP) and 6x64 to 9x64 (BOT)'. The second subfigure includes, in order, 2x64, 3x64, 4x128, 5x128, 6x64, 7x64, 8x64 and 9x64 (v2 l.1412-1447). Eight panels of 0.24\linewidth set four to a row, and the rendered page 20 shows two rows of four. ablation/2spiral/ has no 4x64.png or 5x64.png. Its 16 files have pairwise distinct md5 sums, so 4x128.png and 5x128.png are not copies of other panels. The PNGs carry no size label, so the file names are the only evidence of the sizes; the corrector used them, and nothing contradicts them. The subcaption now matches its panels. The figure's main caption (l.1454, l.1456) is a separate matter (finding 2).

build.notes: latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error main.tex was run in two /tmp copies, each with main.aux, main.bbl, main.log and the latexmk state removed so that bibtex ran. One copy is of the working copy (.git dropped) and one is a git archive of 256b365. Both exit 0 with 20 pages, no undefined reference or citation, and no rerun request. The base log has the 10 lines 'Label `fig:toyimg' multiply defined' / 'fig:toyimg@cref' plus 'There were multiply-defined labels'. The v2 log has none of them. Apart from those lines, the two logs' warning lists are identical: the amsthm 'Unknown theoremstyle fact' and the hyperref 'Ignoring empty anchor', both pre-existing. The aux file gives sec:size_ablation = {E}{16}{appendix.E}, fig:toyimg = {2}{8}, fig:depth_ablation = 6, fig:minimal_checker = 7, fig:size_star = 8, fig:size_circles = 9 and fig:size_spirals = 10. pdftotext shows 'either a flat torus T2, or sphere S2 (the size ablations of Appendix E are run on R2).', 'Figure 2 shows how Moser Flow fails' (base: 'Figure 10'), 'A. Fundamentals of EGFs' with no comma after it (base: a lone ','), and the new two-spirals subcaption. Both /tmp copies were deleted afterwards. Aside: the working copy's ignored main.pdf and its tracked main.bbl have mtimes of 14:26, so someone built in place. main.bbl is byte-identical (no git change), so nothing reaches the diff.

answers_to_master.label_in_scope_and_E_right: Yes to both. The section label prints nothing and is the minimal mechanism for the corrected's reference. E is right: in both the base and the v2 build, the size ablations are 'E. Ablation study on the size of EGF'. The register's 'Appendix F' (in the finding and the corrected) is wrong, and so is the header of ~/egf-reproduction/configs/ablations_r2.toml (l.1, l.17), which copied it.
answers_to_master.labels_match_and_refs_resolve: Yes. Each of the five new labels matches its figure's \includegraphics and caption. The one \ref{fig:toyimg} (l.518) now prints Figure 2, which is the comparison figure the sentence means.
answers_to_master.l1409_matches_panels: Yes. The row order is 2x64, 3x64, 4x128, 5x128 / 6x64-9x64, the file set has no 4x64 or 5x64, and the md5 sums are distinct.
answers_to_master.l431_true_of_appendix_E: Yes, on the natural reading of 'the size ablations'. Figures 8-10 state R^2. Figure 6 states no space, but its images are in the R^2 frame. Figure 7 is on T^2, but it is a single-size run, not an ablation, and its caption says T^2. Finding 3 proposes making this explicit.
answers_to_master.two_spirals_main_caption: This is not within C-37's scope as adopted. The corrected names only 'the caption of l.1409', which is the subcaption. The main caption's range 'from 2x32 to 9x64' is at v1 l.1412, which is not in printed. v1 l.1414 is in printed, but the finding cites it only as evidence of the R^2 setting and the 8 translations, and the finding never calls the main caption's range wrong. The summary's 'state the ablations' ... sizes' is broader, but the corrected is the operative text. So the corrector was right not to edit it, and it is a new typo for the planner (finding 2).
answers_to_master.depth_ablation_state_space: Its caption (l.1040) states no state space. That is a gap for the planner (finding 3), not something this batch was asked to fix.
